# 022-hotel

**Provider.** Hilton (Hilton Honors), direct booking at a DoubleTree by Hilton property, British English.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. White Hilton header with the Honors name, tier and masked member number, a navy band with the confirmation number, a three-column arrival/departure/room strip, stay details, nightly rate table, cancellation policy and hotel policies.

**Why.** The sender display name is the hotel while the provider is Hilton. Check-in and check-out are 24-hour times in a compact strip; dates are abbreviated British style ("Fri 3 Dec 2027"), while the cancellation sentence switches to "11:59 PM" and "01 Dec 2027". Two nightly rates and a zero tax line add up to the total; the cancellation charge (one night) and the incidentals pre-authorisation of 50.00 GBP per night are distractors. Two adults stay but only one is named.
